name: Templates
description: Fake core plugin for internal templates.

EXTERNAL_TEMPLATE_URLS.help: List of service template URLs to download and install, separated with spaces. Each URL is one template: a bunkerweb-template/1 JSON package, or a .zip or .tar.gz holding <id>/template.json and its configs. Only https:// and file:/// are accepted, at most 1 MiB. Append #sha256=<digest> to a URL to pin its content. A template whose URL is removed is deleted unless a service still uses it.
EXTERNAL_TEMPLATE_URLS.label: External template URLs
